name: qsreplace
summary: Accept URLs on stdin, replace all query string values with a user-supplied value, only output each combination of query string parameters once per host and path.
highlights: -a — Append the value instead of replacing it
-ignore-path — Ignore the path when considering what constitutes a duplicate

flags.name: -a
flags.description: Append the value instead of replacing it

flags.name: -ignore-path
flags.description: Ignore the path when considering what constitutes a duplicate
